# 歷史 / History: course outline

**Version 1, 2026-11-28.** 5 parts, 15 chapters, about 7.5 hours of lessons.  
Core: 0 parts, 0 chapters. Tracks: sprint-116.  
Papers: social. Paths: 社會 (`social`). Status: planned.

## Decisions

- 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied the required subject in school; the full zero-to-hero core follows for 117.
- Owner (2026-11-28): the 社會 sprint has about 57 chapters (歷史 15, 地理 20, 公民 19, 社會綜合 3), at most 5 codes per 30-minute chapter as in the science sprint.
- Owner (2026-11-28): one subject at a time in the order 地理 → 公民 → 歷史, then the shared 社會綜合 part (social.json).
- Owner (2026-11-28): no new components for the sprint. Sources and statutes are quoted blocks with provenance and an as-of date, attributed readings use Perspective, maps are schematic Graph drawings labelled 示意圖, time-sensitive values use Fact, and drawing items are rubric self-checks.
- Teaching order follows research/verified-2026-11-15.json final_units; every official dependsOn edge between covered codes is respected.
- Practice items are original and only modelled on the 111–115 papers; official papers are linked, never copied.
- The sprint follows the 課綱 themes A→O (research final_units order); the 國中 chronological backbones of the full design are not repeated, and needed 國中 facts are recapped in place.
- Contested codes (design 03 §1.5): Da-Ⅴ-2 and Db-Ⅴ-2 get chapters of their own, so the contested-topic gate covers as little else as possible; F-Ⅴ-1 and Nb-Ⅴ-2 sit in their themes' chapters, which are flagged contested as a whole.
- 歷史考察 E, J and O have no content of their own and are tested through skills (115 Q38), so they are reviewed together in the history exam-skills chapter.
- Sources are SourceCard-style quoted blocks (who, when, why, for whom; type; what it can and cannot show), with recorded provenance, public-domain or open-licensed only.

## Open questions

1. Da-Ⅴ-2: the 課綱 names only document types. Which treaties, declarations, resolutions and communiqués the chapter shows, and their official archive URLs, are not in the frozen research; the owner must approve the list (link plus short quote; foreign-government document reuse is open).
2. Licences of 國史館 and 國家人權博物館 materials are open (design 03 §1.3); until settled, s116-228-white-terror-justice links them and quotes briefly.
3. History/civics 考試說明 例題 numbers come from the older 108年9月 file (design 03 §0.4); they can't be re-checked against the 108.11.08 file without new research.
4. Ib-Ⅴ-2 needs a short primer on 共產主義 and 社會主義, which the 課綱 teaches only later in Lb-Ⅴ-2; the primer is given in place, with a link forward.
5. Exam-item links (examItems) and reviewed concepts (reviews) are added per chapter in S2.
